studied: 2026-09-29 (from the agent's recordings of Rackspace, Aristocrat, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana and sites/workday.py)
steps: My Information -> My Experience -> Application Questions -> Voluntary Disclosures -> (Self Identify) -> Review; progress bar lists 'completed step N of M' before 'current step M of M'
account: an account (or 'Apply Manually' after sign-in) is needed; see BEHAVIOUR.md 'The account step'

fields.ids: stable data-automation-id attributes (promptOption, selectedItem, multiSelectContainer, dateSectionMonth-input, dateSectionYear-input, progressBarActiveStep, signInForm ...)

single_choice.widget: a button named '<question> Select One Required' (aria-haspopup=listbox); the list opens in a portal as role=listbox with role=option items
single_choice.pick: click the button, click the option whose text equals the answer

search_and_pick.widget: a textbox with placeholder 'Search' (Country Phone Code, How Did You Hear, School, Field of Study, Skills) inside multiSelectContainer, with a prompt icon
search_and_pick.options: [data-automation-id=promptOption] carrying the exact text in data-automation-label; some lists are two levels (a category, then the item)
search_and_pick.value_shown: a listbox 'items selected' holding an option '<value>, press delete to clear value' and a hidden '1 item selected, <value>' line -- the textbox itself stays empty
search_and_pick.pick: type the value, wait for promptOption items, click the one whose data-automation-label equals the answer; confirm it appears under 'items selected'
search_and_pick.weakness: the current code falls back to 'the option contains the answer' when nothing is equal -- 'Virginia' can take 'West Virginia'; the fallback must be removed or made word-exact

fields.multi_choice: the same prompt widget allowing several items (Skills, Languages)

dates.widget: a composite date: spinbutton inputs dateSectionMonth-input and dateSectionYear-input with ids '<section>-<n>--<startDate|endDate>-dateSection<Part>-input'
dates.pick: focus the first part and TYPE the digits as one stream (MMYYYY); setting a part's value directly scrambles the others

fields.repeated_entries: Work Experience N and Education N groups added with 'Add' / 'Add Another'; each entry must be saved ('Save') before Next
fields.yes_no: single-choice buttons 'Select One' with Yes/No options
fields.phone: Country Phone Code (search-and-pick, 'United States of America (+1)'), Phone Device Type (single choice), Phone Number
fields.file: input type=file under 'Resume/CV' ('Upload a file (5MB max)' / 'Select files'); a separate 'Autofill with Resume' on the first page re-fills the form
fields.errors: an 'Errors Found' panel listing each field after Next
